description: issue #201: a bare zero-argument `right` raises `ol-not-enough-inputs` — the static checker's arity rule never runs inside `execute()` (only `parse()` does), so this is the sole runtime guard against silently treating a callee-only `right` as a no-op. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
